items.domain: EPH release-format admission and inherited break governance
items.summary: Admits INDEC EPH's modern per-quarter 'EPH_usu_{q}_Trim_{year}_txt.zip' release (individual + hogar text bases, accompanied by INDEC's own 'EPH_registro_{q}T{year}.pdf' record layout) as the LABOR-admitted transport format for this source; the legacy DBF transport ('t{q}{yy}_dbf.zip') and any bare '_Trim_{year}.zip' variant are not admitted by this ruling. LABOR inherits V1's GOV-008 umbrella ruling in full for this source: the five EPH statistical breaks V1 already ruled MATERIAL and NOT_HOMOGENEOUS -- BRK-INDEC-EPH-2015-2016-DISCONTINUITY, BRK-INDEC-EPH-2019-OPERATIONAL-CHANGE, BRK-INDEC-EPH-2020-COVID-COLLECTION, BRK-INDEC-EPH-2023-Q4-INFORMAL-LABOUR, and BRK-INDEC-EPH-2024-Q4-INCOME-MEASUREMENT -- remain binding NO_SPLICE boundaries for any LABOR claim; this ruling does not re-litigate, weaken, or re-open any of them, and does not construct a bridge across any of them (GOV-008's own bridge_status for all five is NO-BRIDGE/ACCEPTED_LIMITATION). VALID_COMPARABILITY_WINDOWS (updated LAB-A2.1, 2026-09-18): LABOR now holds two releases, 2025-Q1 and 2026-Q1, both within the post-2024-Q4-break regime, the most recent of the five ruled windows; the pair {2025-Q1, 2026-Q1} is COMPARABLE_WITH_LIMITATIONS (no GOV-008 boundary crossed; limitations: PP07H is blank for 55.25% of 2026-Q1 individual rows by design, not data loss, since it applies only to a subset of respondents, and the 2025-Q1 individual base carries one extra column, CAT_INAC, absent from 2026-Q1, affecting none of the variables this pair is used for). No comparability determination is made for any other window because LABOR has not retrieved data from any other window (LAB-A2.1 instruction: retrieve only what is required, not full EPH history). INVALID_WINDOWS / NO_SPLICE boundaries: any future LABOR retrieval spanning 2015-Q3/2016-Q2, 2018-Q4/2019-Q1, 2020-Q1/2020-Q2, 2023-Q3/2023-Q4, or 2024-Q3/2024-Q4 must not be treated as a homogeneous series across that boundary without a dedicated future LAB-GOV-EPH ruling constructing and justifying a bridge. This ruling authorizes admission of the retrieved release for future hypothesis execution (LAB-HYP-0003 and other EPH-dependent hypotheses); it does not itself execute any hypothesis or produce any labour-market claim.

items.domain: IPC release admission, base-period scope, and inherited break governance
items.summary: Admits INDEC's national IPC 'serie_ipc_divisiones.csv' (nivel general and COICOP divisions/groups plus bienes/servicios, base diciembre 2016=100, national total and six statistical regions) as a PRICE_INDEX-class source (LAB-OBJ-0025), for future use strictly as a deflator input, not as a labour-market object in its own right. LABOR inherits V1's GOV-008 umbrella ruling in full for this source: BRK-INDEC-IPC-2007-2015-COMPARABILITY and BRK-INDEC-IPC-2016-2017-RESTART remain binding, ruled NOT_HOMOGENEOUS with NO-BRIDGE/ACCEPTED_LIMITATION bridge_status; this ruling does not re-litigate, weaken, or re-open either. Because the file LABOR retrieved begins exactly at the base month (2016-12) and contains no pre-2016 data, no internal splice is attempted or required within the admitted file itself; VALID_COMPARABILITY_WINDOWS for the admitted file is the single continuous window 2016-12 through 2026-08 (its full retrieved extent), all one base (Dec-2016=100), with no internal base change observed. INVALID_WINDOWS: any future extension to a pre-2016 IPC vintage (IPC-GBA base Abr-2008, or IPC Nacional urbano base Oct2013-Sep2014) must not be spliced to this file without a dedicated future LAB-GOV-IPC ruling, per BRK-INDEC-IPC-2007-2015-COMPARABILITY and BRK-INDEC-IPC-2016-2017-RESTART. PROHIBITED_USE (explicit): this ruling authorizes IPC's admission as a validated deflator input; it does NOT authorize computation of REAL_WAGE, REAL_LABOR_INCOME, an inflation rate, or any other real-terms/deflated quantity, and does NOT execute LAB-HYP-0004 or any other hypothesis. Any such computation requires a separate future authorization (LAB-A3 or later).

items.domain: Admission of official Argentine regulatory sources and a governed observable-category mapping for LAB-Q-0012 (protections/obligations across tax/registration modalities)
items.summary: Admits eight official Argentine primary regulatory sources (six Boletin Oficial laws, two ARCA operational-guidance pages; full detail reports/lab_b3/LAB-B3-regulatory-sources.json) as LAB-SRC-0004 through LAB-SRC-0011, and rules a governed mapping between LAB-Q-0012's three observable registration categories (TRABAJADOR_REGISTRADO_DEPENDIENTE, MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION/LAB-OBJ-0016, AUTONOMOS_REGISTRATION/LAB-OBJ-0026) and their documented tax/pension obligations, labour-law protections, and social-security coverage (full mapping: reports/lab_b3/LAB-B3-governed-mapping.json). ADMITTED SOURCES: LAB-SRC-0004 Ley 20.744 (Ley de Contrato de Trabajo, sanc. 1974-09-05, B.O. 1974-09-27 No.23003, texto ordenado Decreto 390/1976); LAB-SRC-0005 Ley 23.660 (Obras Sociales, sanc. 1988-12-29, B.O. 1989-01-20); LAB-SRC-0006 Ley 24.977 (Monotributo, texto actualizado, sanc. 1998-06-03, B.O. 1998-07-06 No.28931); LAB-SRC-0007 Ley 24.241 (SIPA, sanc. 1993-09-23, B.O. 1993-10-18 No.27745 -- admitted here for its REGULATORY TEXT specifically; its statistical data has been referenced by LAB-ROOT-0001 since LAB-A, a distinct use); LAB-SRC-0008 Ley 24.557 (Riesgos del Trabajo, sanc. 1995-09-13, B.O. 1995-10-04 No.28242); LAB-SRC-0009 Ley 24.714 (Asignaciones Familiares, sanc. 1996-10-02, B.O. 1996-10-18 No.28503); LAB-SRC-0010 and LAB-SRC-0011, ARCA's own official operational-guidance pages on the Autonomos regime and the Monotributo obra-social component respectively (afip.gob.ar, no fixed publication date, content as retrieved 2026-09-18). ADMISSION CRITERIA (explicit): official primary sources only -- sanctioned legislation via servicios.infoleg.gob.ar / argentina.gob.ar/normativa (Ministerio de Justicia) or ARCA's own portal; blogs, accounting-firm write-ups, and press/journalistic articles were explicitly excluded as regulatory evidence, even where found during research. KEY MAPPED FINDINGS (ESTABLISHED, full detail and citations in the mapping artifact): dependientes are the only category listed as OBLIGATORY obra social beneficiaries (Ley 23.660 Art.8 inciso a); Monotributo's monthly cuota bundles an obra social component and a reduced SIPA pension contribution (Ley 24.977 Art.39); autonomos' aportes give access to the same SIPA-administered prestaciones a dependiente would have 'excepto las asignaciones familiares' (ARCA's own official quote, LAB-SRC-0010); ART coverage is obligatory only for dependientes, with autonomos/monotributistas incorporable only by Poder Ejecutivo decree (Ley 24.557). OPEN_NOT_RESOLVED, left explicitly unresolved rather than completed by inference: LCT-style labour protections (indemnizacion, vacaciones, SAC) were not catalogued article-by-article for any category this phase; ART and seguro de desempleo status for Monotributo specifically; asignaciones familiares for Monotributo specifically (only press sources found, explicitly inadmissible as primary regulatory evidence per this ruling's own admission criteria). FORBIDDEN ASSUMPTIONS explicitly not made anywhere in the mapping: Monotributo does not equal total absence of protection (refuted in part by the ESTABLISHED obra-social/SIPA findings); Autonomo does not equal empleado; tax/registration record does not equal labour relationship (Regime B's frozen TAX_REGISTRATION != EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP prohibition, reaffirmed); no legal/regulatory difference documented here is asserted to imply an automatic causal or economic difference. SCOPE (explicit): this ruling and its mapping artifact make NO comparative, causal, or economic claim between the three categories, and do NOT adjudicate LAB-Q-0012 -- LAB-Q-0012 remains open, to be answered, if at all, by a future, separately authorized execution phase using exactly this governed mapping (and no new source) as its evidentiary basis. No hypothesis was created or executed. No new LAB-OBJ was created: the three categories map to already-existing LAB-OBJ-0005/0015 (TRABAJADOR_REGISTRADO_DEPENDIENTE), LAB-OBJ-0016 (MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION), and LAB-OBJ-0026 (AUTONOMOS_REGISTRATION).

items.domain: Selection and governance of a Monotributo threshold-change episode for LAB-HYP-0006's regression-discontinuity-in-time design
items.summary: Evaluates four candidate Monotributo tax-category threshold-change episodes against LAB-HYP-0006's own pre-registered design (treatment: a Monotributo threshold change; outcome: discontinuity in the rate of transition between EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP, LAB-OBJ-0003, and MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION, LAB-OBJ-0016; CANDIDATE_SOURCES: ARCA only). Full per-episode documentation: reports/lab_b4/LAB-B4-episode-sources.json. CANDIDATES: (1) EP-2021-REFORM, Ley 27.618 (sanc. 2021-04-08, B.O. 2021-04-21), retroactive to 2021-01-01, ~35.31% update later left without effect for Jan-Jun 2021 -- REJECTED, both contaminated (retroactive, partially reversed, overlapping Decreto 337/2021) and unsupported (no 2021 ARCA vintage was ever admitted). (2) EP-2020-ROUTINE, the original annual Art. 52 mechanism (Ley 27.346), effective 2020-01-01 -- REJECTED, because LAB-ROOT-0007's admitted 'boletin-seg-soc-2020.xls' begins exactly at the treatment month itself, leaving no admitted pre-period. (3) EP-2025-FEB, the first semi-annual IPC-indexed update of fiscal year 2025, effective 2025-02-01 -- REJECTED as primary candidate: valid in principle but only a one-month pre-period (January 2025) is admitted within the same file, markedly thinner and more asymmetric than candidate (4). (4) EP-2025-AUG, the second semi-annual IPC-indexed update of fiscal year 2025, effective 2025-08-01 -- SELECTED. Categoria A's annual gross-income limit rose from ARS 7,813,063.45 (vigente 2025-02-01/2025-07-31, LAB-SRC-0012) to ARS 8,992,597.87 (vigente 2025-08-01/2026-01-31, LAB-SRC-0013), +15.10%; Categoria B moved identically in percentage terms (+15.10%), confirming a uniform, mechanical, IPC-indexed update rather than a category-targeted discretionary change (lower manipulation risk). AUTHORIZED PRE/POST WINDOW: 2025-01 through 2025-07 (7 months, pre) and 2025-08 through 2025-12 (5 months, post), both already admitted within LAB-ROOT-0007's existing 'boletin-seg-soc-2025-12.xlsx' -- no new ARCA retrieval required for the treatment-timing/stock side. TREATMENT: the 2025-08-01 category-threshold increase itself (a sharp, law-mandated, formula-driven policy date). COMPARADOR/CONTROL: none in the cross-sectional sense -- this is a regression-discontinuity-IN-TIME design; the counterfactual is the extrapolated pre-period trend within the same admitted series, not a separate control population. Categories further from vs. closer to their own threshold could in principle serve as an internal comparison in a future execution phase's own design choice; this ruling does not specify or mandate one. IDENTIFICATION THREATS (explicit): (a) FUNDAMENTAL -- LAB-ROOT-0007 (ARCA, Cuadro 1) is STOCK data only (a monthly count of active Monotributistas); LAB-HYP-0006's own pre-registered METRIC requires a TRANSITION/FLOW rate ('discontinuity in the rate of transition'), which no admitted ARCA table supplies (LAB-B1 already declared registration-flow/altas-bajas data SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE in every ARCA publication evaluated); a stock-level proxy (e.g. month-over-month stock change) would not implement the pre-registered METRIC as written and this ruling does not authorize substituting one. (b) FUNDAMENTAL -- the outcome's other side, EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP (LAB-OBJ-0003), has been operationalized in this project only via MLER (LAB-ROOT-0003), whose admitted period ends 2021-12 -- four years before the selected episode (2025-08); no admitted or previously-authorized source supplies EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP data for 2025. (c) STRUCTURAL -- no source admitted or substitution-authorized anywhere in this project links a single person across TAX_REGISTRATION/MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION and EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP records (no common person-level identifier has been found across ARCA, SIPA, or MLER; LAB-CLM-0003 already established this absence between EPH and SIPA/MLER, and no different situation is known to hold between ARCA and MLER/SIPA) -- so even a perfectly-windowed episode with both outcome sources admitted could not measure an individual-level TRANSITION rate as pre-registered, only two separate aggregate series observed in parallel. (d) Recategorizacion mechanics around the same date are a mechanical relabeling exercise, not evidence of genuine transition, and are not ruled out as a sub-category measurement artifact. (e) General macroeconomic/labour-market conditions around 2025-08 were not exhaustively checked for other simultaneous policy changes. RULING: episode SELECTED (EP-2025-AUG, 2025-08-01) for its treatment-timing merits; LAB-HYP-0006 remains STILL_BLOCKED, NOT READY_FOR_EXECUTION -- selecting the best-available episode does not, by itself, resolve threats (a)-(c), which are about what LAB-HYP-0006's own pre-registered OUTCOME requires, not about which date is chosen. No causal effect was computed. LAB-HYP-0006 was not adjudicated. LAB-Q-0013 was not closed empirically. This ruling does not modify LAB-HYP-0006's or LAB-Q-0013's own registered fields, does not authorize execution, and does not authorize redefining LAB-HYP-0006's METRIC to a stock-level proxy in place of the pre-registered transition-rate definition.

items.domain: Candidate platform evaluation and source selection for the Job Posting Observatory MVP (LAB-Q-0014)
items.summary: Evaluates four job-posting-source candidates against LAB-C0's own TOS_ROBOTS_API_COMPLIANCE_POLICY, COPYRIGHT_AND_TEXT_RETENTION, and PRIVACY gates (reports/lab_c0/LAB-C0-observatory-design.json), applied as written, not adapted to admit any candidate. Full per-candidate detail: reports/lab_c1/LAB-C1-platform-evaluation.json. CANDIDATES: (1) PLATFORM-BUMERAN (bumeran.com.ar, Navent Group) -- HARD_EXCLUDED: Terms of Service clause 1.5.1 explicitly bans any automated access tool other than Bumeran's own search widgets, with no official research API alternative. (2) PLATFORM-ZONAJOBS (zonajobs.com.ar, same Navent Group as Bumeran) -- NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_ADMITTED: its own Terms of Service text could not be independently retrieved this block (three known URL patterns all resolved to a homepage redirect); given confirmed shared corporate ownership and a byte-for-byte-equivalent robots.txt to Bumeran's, it is folded into Bumeran's non-admission rather than treated as an independently cleared candidate. (3) PLATFORM-COMPUTRABAJO (ar.computrabajo.com, DGNET LTD.) -- HARD_EXCLUDED: Aviso Legal explicitly and specifically prohibits 'Robot/Crawler'-type automated copying; its credentialed iapi.computrabajo.com API is a B2B employer/ATS integration product, not a public research-access feed. (4) PLATFORM-CARTELERA-EMPLEO-PUBLICO (argentina.gob.ar Cartelera Publica Central de Ofertas de Empleo Publico, Ministerio de Desregulacion y Transformacion del Estado) -- NOT_ADMITTED: unlike the three private boards, its Terms of Service contain no automation ban and its content is licensed CC BY 4.0, but it fails independently on two grounds that would each require adapting LAB-C0's own governance to admit (explicitly out of scope this block): its robots.txt disallows the .pdf format carrying the large majority of individual convocatorias, and its convocatorias structurally carry named individuals' full DNI numbers (Jurado/Secretaria Concursal) as a routine field, which does not fit LAB-C0's PRIVACY provision (written for a single incidental recruiter contact only). A separate check of datos.gob.ar (Argentina's open-data catalog) found only aggregate labour-market statistics, no individual job-posting microdata, and was ruled OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than evaluated against the candidate gate. FINAL RULING: NO_ADMISSIBLE_CANDIDATE_FOUND -- no platform is admitted for MVP capture at this time. LAB-Q-0014 remains unexecuted; no corpus was created; no posting was captured; no scraping or API call was made against any candidate during this evaluation. This ruling does not modify reports/lab_c0/LAB-C0-observatory-design.json or reports/lab_c0/LAB-C0-generated-source-policy.json, does not redefine PRIVACY or any other LAB-C0 field, and does not authorize any future capture. FUTURE_RECONSIDERATION_CONDITIONS (documented, not authorized): a private platform could become admissible if it publishes a public research-scoped API; the Cartelera's HTML-only subset could become admissible if a future, separately authorized block explicitly revisits the PRIVACY provision; a different, not-yet-evaluated candidate could be brought for evaluation in a later block. None of these is decided or authorized by this ruling.

items.domain: Second and final bounded round of candidate platform evaluation for the Job Posting Observatory MVP (LAB-Q-0014)
items.summary: Evaluates four further job-posting-source candidates -- Remote OK, We Work Remotely, Indeed, and LinkedIn Jobs -- against LAB-C0's own TOS_ROBOTS_API_COMPLIANCE_POLICY, COPYRIGHT_AND_TEXT_RETENTION, PRIVACY, and COVERAGE/GEOGRAPHIC_FILTER gates (reports/lab_c0/LAB-C0-observatory-design.json), applied as written, not adapted to admit any candidate. Bumeran, ZonaJobs, Computrabajo, and the Cartelera Publica Central de Ofertas de Empleo Publico (LAB-C1) were not re-evaluated, per instruction; no new material evidence about any of them emerged. Full per-candidate detail: reports/lab_c1_1/LAB-C1.1-platform-evaluation.json. CANDIDATES: (1) PLATFORM-REMOTEOK (remoteok.com) -- NOT_ADMITTED: the strongest automation/legal profile of any candidate evaluated in either round (a free, public, unauthenticated JSON API and RSS feed, no automation ban, and an explicit robots.txt permission for AI/LLM crawlers including ClaudeBot by name), but a live 99-listing sample (2026-09-18) found no Argentina-specific postings and no structured way to isolate Argentina-eligible ones -- fails LAB-C0's own GEOGRAPHIC_FILTER in practice. (2) PLATFORM-WEWORKREMOTELY (weworkremotely.com) -- NOT_ADMITTED: similarly permissive public RSS feed and robots.txt, but a live 84-item sample found zero Argentina- or Latin-America-relevant postings, with a portion of listings explicitly restricting eligibility to a US/Canada/Europe country allow-list that would affirmatively exclude Argentina-based candidates -- fails GEOGRAPHIC_FILTER more decisively than Remote OK. (3) PLATFORM-INDEED (ar.indeed.com) -- NOT_ADMITTED: its historical public Publisher API was permanently discontinued in 2023 and the Publisher Program has remained closed to new publishers since October 2022; the only remaining route is an NDA-gated, sales-led enterprise data partnership, not a route this project can adopt -- no admissible access mechanism exists at all, regardless of otherwise-strong likely Argentina coverage. (4) PLATFORM-LINKEDIN (linkedin.com/jobs) -- HARD_EXCLUDED: User Agreement Section 8.2(2) explicitly bans scraping/automated collection; the one legitimate exception, the Economic Graph Research Program, is a competitive, sandboxed, aggregate-only academic arrangement that would not supply individual posting records even if this project were accepted into it, and is not a currently available or self-serve mechanism. A supplementary ownership check found Konzerta and Multitrabajos (two additional names surfaced during this round's search) both belong to the same Navent Group family already excluded at LAB-C1 -- confirmatory, not new-and-material, evidence -- and were not independently re-evaluated. FINAL RULING: NO_ADMISSIBLE_CANDIDATE_FOUND -- no platform is admitted for MVP capture at this time. RECOMMENDATION (not executed by this ruling): since this was an explicitly bounded, final second search round and no admissible source emerged, a future, separately authorized block should consider formally closing LAB-Q-0014 with a documented source-availability limitation (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE, mirroring the LAB-Q-0013/LAB-HYP-0006 precedent) rather than continuing to expand platform search indefinitely. This ruling does not itself close LAB-Q-0014, does not modify the question ledger's STATUS field, and does not modify reports/lab_c0/LAB-C0-observatory-design.json or reports/lab_c0/LAB-C0-generated-source-policy.json in any way. No posting was captured; no scraping or API call for data collection was made against any candidate; only each candidate's own deliberately public, unauthenticated terms/robots/API documentation was read.

items.domain: Admissibility of SIPA (LAB-ROOT-0001) as a substitute source for LAB-HYP-0005's excluded 'formal dependent registration' term
items.summary: Evaluates whether LAB-ROOT-0001 (SIPA Trabajo Registrado, INDEPENDENT, already admitted for Regime A) may supply LAB-HYP-0005's pre-registered 'formal dependent registration' term, after LAB-B1 excluded ARCA's own Cuadro 1 'Cotizantes dependientes' row from LAB-ROOT-0007's admitted scope (SIPA-republished, GOV-009 discipline) and LAB-B2 adjudicated LAB-HYP-0005 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for lack of that term (reports/lab_b2/LAB-B2-closeout.md). Full eight-part analysis in reports/lab_b2_1/LAB-B2.1-ruling-analysis.md; summarized here. (A) SEMANTIC EQUIVALENCE: SIPA's T.2 ASALARIADO_PRIVADO, ASALARIADO_PUBLICO, and CASAS_PARTICULARES modalities are registered dependent/subordinate-relationship employment categories -- exactly the concept LAB-OBJ-0015 (LEGAL_FORM)'s own IS example names as 'employee', the concept LAB-HYP-0005's METRIC calls 'formal dependent registration'. Strong match. (B) POPULATION COMPATIBILITY: both ARCA's Monotributista count and SIPA's ASALARIADO_*/CASAS_PARTICULARES counts are drawn from persons/contributors within the same SUSS-administered collection system (LAB-ROOT-0001's own COLLECTION_INSTRUMENT: declarations flow through ARCA); ARCA's own Cuadro 1 formula (Autonomos+Dependientes+Monotributistas-Mixtos=Total) already treats Monotributo and Dependiente registrations as parts of one shared universe. Compatible for a within-universe composition-share metric; does not authorize asserting either side represents all Argentine employment (standing project-wide prohibition, unaffected). (C) STATISTICAL-OBJECT COMPATIBILITY: SIPA's modality-level series are CONTRIBUTOR-grain (LAB-OBJ-0013; reports/lab_a/LAB-A-source-universes.md 'OBJECTS: PERSON, CONTRIBUTOR'), not JOB (LAB-OBJ-0002, reserved for CGI) or EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP (LAB-OBJ-0003, reserved for MLER). ARCA's Cuadro 1 is likewise a contributor/Capitas count (reports/lab_b1/LAB-B1-object-mapping.md UNIT). Both sides are the same kind of statistical object; no object conversion is authorized or required, and LAB-OBJ-0016/LAB-OBJ-0006/LAB-OBJ-0013 remain distinct ledger objects, not merged by this ruling. (D) TEMPORAL COMPATIBILITY: LAB-ROOT-0001 covers 2012-01 to 2026-05 monthly, fully containing all three LAB-HYP-0005 target vintages (Dec-2016, 2020, 2025). No gap. (E) DENOMINATOR VALIDITY: summing SIPA modalities as a private analytical denominator (not asserting equivalence to SIPA's own published TOTAL) is already-precedented, GOV-005-compliant practice in this repository (reports/lab_a/LAB-A-decision-log.md's own DECISION on LAB-EVD-0001's composition-share denominator). The same discipline applies here: any future sum of ASALARIADO_PRIVADO+ASALARIADO_PUBLICO+CASAS_PARTICULARES must be disclaimed as a LAB-analytical construct, not SIPA's own TOTAL row. ASALARIADO_PUBLICO specifically carries a mandatory GOV-005 extrapolation caveat (not a direct recount) that must be disclosed if included. (F) INDEPENDENCE AND CIRCULARITY: the ARCA Dependientes row was excluded because it republishes SIPA under ARCA's own cover -- an inadmissible EVIDENCE PATH (ARCA-labeled, SIPA-sourced), not merely a shared phenomenon. Using LAB-ROOT-0001 directly is a different, already-independently-admitted evidence path (the primary producer's, STEySS's, own publication, not a republication) and eliminates that specific circularity: same underlying phenomenon, not same inadmissible evidence path. It does not make SIPA and ARCA independent of each other for Root Counting purposes -- both trace to the same underlying SUSS/ARCA declaration stream (LAB-ROOT-0001's own SHARED_COVERAGE_BIAS) -- so no CONVERGENT claim is or could be authorized from combining them. (G) OVERLAP / DOUBLE-COUNTING: real and structurally acknowledged. ARCA's own Cuadro 1 formula subtracts a Mixtos category specifically because persons can be registered as both Autonomo/Monotributista and Dependiente simultaneously (LAB-EVD-0013's own recorded category counts). No person-level identifier links SIPA's and ARCA's published aggregate tables. A combined Monotributo(ARCA)+ASALARIADO_*(SIPA) denominator therefore cannot be deduplicated for dual-registered (Mixto-type) persons with currently admitted evidence; this inflates the denominator by an unknown, currently unquantifiable amount. Any resulting share must be presented as directionally informative only, never as an exact or mutually-exclusive partition, with this limitation disclosed verbatim in any future claim. (H) COMPATIBILITY WITH THE PRE-REGISTERED HYPOTHESIS: using SIPA's ASALARIADO_*/CASAS_PARTICULARES sum for the 'formal dependent registration' term, paired with ARCA's already-admitted Monotributista count, implements LAB-HYP-0005's own METRIC structurally as written (a share of two named categories) -- not a redefinition, not a different proxy, not incompatible -- subject to the E/G disclosures above. LAB-HYP-0005's own METRIC/EXPECTED_OBSERVATION/FAILURE_CONDITION/POPULATION/PERIOD/CANDIDATE_SOURCES text is NOT modified by this ruling. RULING: SUBSTITUTION AUTHORIZED WITH EXPLICIT LIMITATIONS (the same ADMITTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS-class disposition already used for ARCA's own admission, applied here to a source-substitution decision rather than a fresh admission). AUTHORIZED USE: a future LAB-HYP-0005 execution phase may use LAB-ROOT-0001 (SIPA)'s ASALARIADO_PRIVADO, ASALARIADO_PUBLICO, and CASAS_PARTICULARES T.2 modalities, summed as a LAB-analytical-only denominator component, to instantiate LAB-HYP-0005's 'formal dependent registration' term, paired with LAB-ROOT-0007 (ARCA)'s already-admitted Monotributista counts, for the three already-targeted vintages (Dec-2016, 2020, 2025) or their nearest available SIPA month. PROHIBITED_USE (explicit): (1) this ruling does NOT itself execute LAB-HYP-0005, does NOT change LAB-CLM-0007's INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE state, and does NOT authorize any new quantitative claim -- a separate future execution phase must do that work; (2) any resulting sum must never be asserted as, or used to validate, SIPA's own published TOTAL (GOV-005); (3) no CONVERGENT claim may ever be built from agreement between the ARCA-Monotributo and SIPA-dependent figures (non-independent, same declaration stream); (4) any resulting share/ratio must explicitly disclose the undeduplicated Mixto-type overlap limitation (G) and the ASALARIADO_PUBLICO extrapolation caveat (GOV-005) if that modality is included; (5) this ruling does not authorize touching LAB-Q-0011, LAB-Q-0012, LAB-Q-0013, LAB-HYP-0006, or LAB-HYP-0009; (6) this ruling does not modify LAB-HYP-0005's own registered fields, nor LAB-CLM-0007's STATE. STATUS: LAB-HYP-0005 remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (LAB-CLM-0007 unchanged) until a future execution phase actually computes the metric under this authorization; this ruling only removes the source-authorization blocker LAB-B2 identified, it does not itself resolve the hypothesis.
